description: Structured eval definitions for the API Gateway WebSocket Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across WebSocket API configurations ($connect/$disconnect with DynamoDB connection management, custom routes with route selection expression, Lambda authorizer + WAF integration, route response bidirectional with keepalive, missing route selection expression prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: WebSocket API with $connect/$disconnect routes and DynamoDB connection management
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — $connect/$disconnect routes with Lambda, DynamoDB ConnectionId storage, route selection expression, auto-deploy stage, PostToConnection via ApiGatewayManagementApi
eval_cases.prompt: Create a WebSocket API named my-chat-api in us-east-1. Route selection expression $request.body.action. $connect route invokes Lambda ws-connect-handler (stores ConnectionId in DynamoDB table WebSocketConnections). $disconnect route invokes Lambda ws-disconnect-handler (deletes ConnectionId). Auto-deploy stage prod. Tags: Environment=production, Service=chat.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WEBSOCKET_API: my-chat-api (abc123def4)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] WebSocket API: abc123def4 (my-chat-api)
  [✓] Route selection expression: $request.body.action
  [✓] $connect route: conn-route → Lambda: ws-connect-handler (stores ConnectionId)
  [✓] $disconnect route: disc-route → Lambda: ws-disconnect-handler (deletes ConnectionId)
  [✓] Integration type: Lambda (AWS_PROXY)
  [✓] Deployment: auto-deploy on stage prod
  [✓] Connection management: DynamoDB WebSocketConnections (store on $connect, delete on $disconnect)
  [✓] Lambda resource-based policy: grants lambda:InvokeFunction to apigateway.amazonaws.com
  [✓] Message size limit: 128 KB
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws apigatewayv2 get-api --api-id abc123def4 --region us-east-1
  aws apigatewayv2 get-routes --api-id abc123def4 --region us-east-1
  aws dynamodb describe-table --table-name WebSocketConnections --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: WebSocket API with custom routes and route selection expression
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — custom routes (sendMessage, joinRoom, leaveRoom), $default route, route selection expression matching message format, DynamoDB connection management
eval_cases.prompt: Create a WebSocket API named my-collab-api in us-east-1. Route selection expression $request.body.action. Custom routes: sendMessage (Lambda ws-message-handler), joinRoom (Lambda ws-room-handler), leaveRoom (Lambda ws-room-handler). $connect stores ConnectionId in DynamoDB CollaboratorConnections. $default route for unmatched messages. Auto-deploy stage prod. Tags: Environment=production, Service=collab.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WEBSOCKET_API: my-collab-api (def456ghi7)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] WebSocket API: def456ghi7 (my-collab-api)
  [✓] Route selection expression: $request.body.action
  [✓] Custom routes: sendMessage, joinRoom, leaveRoom, $default
  [✓] Integration type: Lambda (AWS_PROXY)
  [✓] Connection management: DynamoDB CollaboratorConnections

eval_cases.name: WebSocket API with Lambda custom authorizer and WAF integration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Lambda authorizer ws-auth on $connect (identity source: query string token), WAF Web ACL for IP rate limiting, DynamoDB connection management
eval_cases.prompt: Create a WebSocket API named my-secure-ws-api in us-east-1. Route selection expression $request.body.action. Lambda custom authorizer ws-auth on $connect (identity source: query string token). WAF Web ACL ws-waf for IP rate limiting on stage prod. $connect stores ConnectionId in DynamoDB SecureConnections. Routes: sendMessage, broadcast. Auto-deploy stage prod. Tags: Environment=production, Service=secure-realtime.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WEBSOCKET_API: my-secure-ws-api (ghi789jkl0)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Custom authorizer: ws-auth on $connect (identity source: $request.querystring.token)
  [✓] WAF: ws-waf on stage prod (IP rate limiting)
  [✓] Connection management: DynamoDB SecureConnections
  [✓] Routes: sendMessage, broadcast

eval_cases.name: WebSocket API with route responses for bidirectional communication and keepalive
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — route response on sendMessage for bidirectional, ping route for client heartbeat (60s interval), 128 KB message limit noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a WebSocket API named my-bidirectional-api in us-east-1. Route selection expression $request.body.action. Enable route response on sendMessage route for bidirectional communication. Add ping route for client heartbeat (interval 60s). $connect and $disconnect manage ConnectionId in DynamoDB BidirectionalConnections. Auto-deploy stage prod. Tags: Environment=production, Service=realtime-bidirectional.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WEBSOCKET_API: my-bidirectional-api (jkl012mno3)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Route responses (bidirectional): enabled on sendMessage
  [✓] Keepalive: client-side application heartbeat (interval: 60s)
  [✓] ping route for heartbeat
  [✓] Message size limit: 128 KB

eval_cases.name: WebSocket API without route selection expression (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — route selection expression not provided; custom routes cannot fire without it
eval_cases.prompt: Create a WebSocket API named my-incomplete-api in us-east-1. I want custom routes sendMessage and joinRoom but I don't know what route selection expression to use. Just create it.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WEBSOCKET_API: N/A
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Route selection expression: not provided — required for custom routes (sendMessage, joinRoom) to fire
